kontrol: Logo ve görseller keskin, orantılı, doğru zeminde; pikselli, ezilmiş, ters renk logo FAIL. Müşteriye: Marka işareti ucuz görünmemeli.

kontrol: İlk üç saniye (açılış / kahraman / splash) geri kalanla aynı ürün. Vitrin ayrı, içerisi ayrı FAIL. Müşteriye: İlk bakış ile içerisi birbirini tutmalı.

E-posta ve İletişim Altyapısı (Transactional Messaging)
Şablon Tasarımları: Sistem e-postalarının (Hoş geldin, şifre sıfırlama, bülten) kurumsal kimliğe ve mobil tasarıma uygun olması.
E-posta İletim Oranı (Deliverability): Gönderilen e-postaların kullanıcıların "Spam" klasörüne düşmeden doğrudan gelen kutusuna ulaşması (SPF/DKIM ayarları).
Abonelikten Ayrılma (Unsubscribe): Pazarlama veya bildirim maillerinde kullanıcıların tek tıkla listeden çıkabilmesi.
SMS / OTP Doğrulama: Telefon numarası doğrulama gereken durumlarda tek kullanımlık şifrelerin (OTP) saniyeler içinde iletilmesi.

Dil Değişimi: Uygulama dili değiştirildiğinde tüm metinlerin eksiksiz ve doğru şekilde çevrilmesi.
RTL (Sağdan Sola) Desteği: Arapça gibi sağdan sola yazılan dillerde arayüz yerleşiminin otomatik uyarlanması.
Tarih, Saat ve Para Birimi: Tarih formatlarının ve sayısal değerlerin yerel standartlara göre gösterilmesi.
Dil değişince tüm görünür metinler (tab, hata, boş durum, sistem diyaloğu metinleri) güncellensin.
RTL dillerde layout, ikon yönü ve kaydırma yönü aynalansın; kırık overlap olmasın.
Tarih, sayı, yüzde ve para formatı seçilen locale'e göre gösterilsin.
Eksik çeviri ham key göstermesin; İngilizce'ye düşsün (TR/ana dil key'i varken EN'e zorlanmasın).
Dil tercihi kalıcı olsun; yeniden açılışta sıfırlanmasın.
Desteklenen her locale için dil dosyası yüklensin; eksik dosya uygulamayı çökertmesin.
Çoğul, interpolation ve nested key'ler tüm dillerde aynı şemayı kullansın.
AR, FR, DE, ES, JA, PT, RU, ZH ve diğer ikincil dillerde eksik key İngilizce'ye düşsün.
Ana dil (ör. TR) ve EN first-class kalsın; ana dil key'i varken EN'e düşülmesin.

**Secrets Extraction:** Extract all hardcoded credentials, API keys, JWT secrets, connection strings, and private keys into `.env` files.
**Git History Purging:** Sanitize Git history using `git filter-repo` or `BFG Repo-Cleaner` if any `.env` or secret was ever committed.
**Environment Security:** Ensure `.env*`, `*.pem`, `*.key`, `*.keystore`, and `google-services.json` are strictly added to `.gitignore`.

**Client-Side Secret Shielding:** Never store or expose private API keys (e.g., Stripe Secret Key, AWS Access Key, database credentials) inside Web or Mobile client-side code. Use dedicated backend proxy endpoints for external integrations.
**Password Hashing:** Hash passwords using Argon2id or bcrypt (minimum work factor 12). Never use MD5, SHA-1, or plain SHA-256.
**JWT Security & Rotation:** Use short-lived Access Tokens (e.g., 15 mins) and long-lived, single-use Refresh Tokens with automatic token rotation and revocation list in Redis.
**Cookie Hardening:** Set cookies with `HttpOnly`, `Secure`, `SameSite=Strict`, and explicit `Domain`/`Path` attributes.

**Rate Limiting & Brute-Force Protection:** Implement IP-based and user-based Rate Limiting (Redis Sliding Window or Token Bucket) on critical routes (`/login`, `/register`, `/forgot-password`, `/verify-otp`, `/reset-password`).
**Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA/2FA):** Enforce TOTP / WebAuthn support for elevated actions and administrative accounts.
**Account Lockout:** Temporarily lock accounts after N consecutive failed login attempts to prevent brute-force attacks.
**Session Termination & Invalidation:** Invalidate server-side sessions instantly on logout, password change, or suspicious activity.
**Account Deletion (GDPR/KVKK Compliance):** Ensure "Delete Account" permanently purges or anonymizes all user PII from Primary DB, Redis Caches, S3 Buckets, and 3rd-party analytics.

**Server-Side Authorization (BOLA/IDOR):** Validate user ownership and resource context strictly on the backend API layer. Never trust client-provided IDs without verifying if `request.user.id == resource.owner_id`.
**RBAC & ABAC:** Enforce Role-Based Access Control and Attribute-Based Access Control on administrative, financial, and management endpoints.
**Private Storage & Storage ACLs:** Keep cloud buckets (AWS S3, Azure Blob) private by default. Access files via time-limited Signed URLs / Pre-signed GET-PUT operations.
**Mass Assignment Protection:** Use DTOs (Data Transfer Objects) / White-listing on incoming requests to prevent model binding pollution (e.g., users setting `isAdmin = true`).

**Strict Schema Validation:** Validate incoming request payloads, headers, query parameters, and route params using strict schemas (Zod, FluentValidation, Joi, Dantic). Reject extra/unknown properties.
**SQL Injection & NoSQLi Protection:** Use Parameterized Queries or ORM (EF Core, Prisma, Dapper, TypeORM) exclusively. Prohibit raw dynamic string concatenation inside raw database queries.
**XSS & Contextual Output Encoding:** Escape all user-generated content rendered in HTML/React DOM. Sanitize HTML input with DOMPurify if HTML rendering is mandatory.
Enforce file extension whitelisting (never trust user file extensions).
Validate file headers / magic bytes (e.g., check PNG signature `89 50 4E 47`).
Enforce maximum file size limits on reverse proxy and app layers.
Strip EXIF / GPS metadata from uploaded images.
Store files using UUID-generated filenames outside the web root directory.

**SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery) Mitigation:** Validate and whitelist destination URLs before making outbound HTTP requests from the server. Block internal IP ranges (`127.0.0.1`, `10.0.0.0/8`, `192.168.0.0/16`, AWS IMDS `169.254.169.254`).
**TLS & HTTPS Enforcement:** Enforce HTTPS strictly across all environments. Redirect HTTP traffic to HTTPS with HSTS (`Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload`).
**Strict CORS Policy:** Lock down CORS policies. Disable wildcard origins (`*`) in production. Specify exact trusted domain origins, allowed headers, and HTTP methods.
**HTTP Security Headers:** Inject essential headers on all responses:
`Content-Security-Policy (CSP)`
`X-Frame-Options: DENY` (Clickjacking protection)
`X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` (MIME-sniffing protection)
`Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`
`Permissions-Policy` (Restrict camera, microphone, geolocation APIs)
**Webhook Signature Verification:** Validate incoming webhooks (Stripe, GitHub, payment gateways) using HMAC-SHA256 signatures before processing payloads.
**Reverse Proxy & WAF:** Place backend services behind a Web Application Firewall (Cloudflare, AWS WAF) to filter DDoS, bad bots, and malicious payloads.

**Production Error Masking:** Suppress detailed stack traces, internal paths, database exceptions, and framework details in production. Return generic standardized error responses (e.g., `{"error": "An unexpected error occurred"}`).
**Log Sanitization & PII Filtering:** Mask or scrub sensitive data (Passwords, Credit Card numbers, JWTs, Access Tokens, Social Security numbers) before writing to application logs.
**Audit Logging:** Record security events (failed logins, privilege escalation, password resets, key rotation, admin actions) with timestamps, IP addresses, and user IDs.
**Billing & Cost Monitoring Alerts:** Configure automated cost threshold alerts on AWS, GCP, Cloudflare, and Sentry to detect and mitigate L7 DDoS and resource exhaustion attacks.
**Dependency Vulnerability Audits:** Run automated dependency vulnerability scans (`npm audit`, `dotnet list package --vulnerable`, Snyk, Trivy) and eliminate critical/high vulnerabilities.

**Secure Local Storage:** Never store sensitive user tokens, JWTs, or encryption keys in `AsyncStorage`, `localStorage`, or unencrypted SQLite databases. Use `expo-secure-store`, iOS Keychain, or Android EncryptedSharedPreferences / Keystore.
**Certificate Pinning (SSL Pinning):** Implement SSL/TLS Certificate Pinning on mobile network layers to prevent Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) interception on untrusted networks (public Wi-Fi).
**Jailbreak / Root Detection:** Detect compromised mobile operating systems (Jailbroken iOS / Rooted Android) and block execution or disable sensitive features.
**Code Obfuscation & Binary Protection:** Obfuscate JS bundles, enable ProGuard/R8 for Android, and strip debugging symbols before generating App Store / Google Play release builds.
**Screen Capture & Overlay Protection:** Disable screenshot/screen recording capabilities on sensitive views (e.g., payment, personal identity, credentials screens).
**Biometric Authentication:** Secure local app opening with FaceID / TouchID / Biometric Prompt integrated with native hardware keystores.
**Automated Static Analysis (SAST):** Run SAST tools (SonarQube, Semgrep) to identify code-level security issues during CI/CD builds.
**Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST):** Test live APIs and web surfaces with tools like OWASP ZAP or Burp Suite.
